### Prepare the revised dataset

```{r}
# Original row-based exclusion: preserve the sample order used by this analysis.
whole_df<-whole_df[c(1,3:239),]
whole_df$sex<-as.factor(whole_df$sex)
whole_df$ADNI.petpos<-as.factor(whole_df$ADNI.petpos)
whole_df$Educg<-as.factor(whole_df$Educg)
```

```{r}
whole_df<-whole_df%>%
  dplyr::rename(Amygdala = bi_Amygdala, Putamen = bi_Putamen, Inferiortemporal = bi_inferiortemporal, Inferiorparietal = bi_inferiorparietal, Entorhinal = bi_entorhinal, Precuneus = bi_precuneus)
  
```

### Select data for lm analysis
```{r}
# Preserve the exact variables selected for the revised regression models.
whole_df<-whole_df[,c(2:7,20,62:120)]
```

```{r}
# Assign feature families to the regression distributions used in the revision.
# feat1: zero-inflated beta; feat2: Gamma; feat3: negative binomial;
# remaining continuous features: Gaussian.
feat1 <- c("adjectivesRate",
"adverbsRate",
"conjunctionsRate",
"interjectionsRate", 
"noiseRate",
"noiseSentencesRate",
"particlesRate",
"uniqueAdjectivesRate",
"uniqueAdverbsRate",
"uniqueInterjectionsRate",
"uniqueParticlesRate"
)

# type 2: > 0 , right skewed
# model: gamma regression
feat2 <- c(
"pronounProperNounRatio", 
"standardizedPauseRate"
)

# type 3: count variables, with many zeros
# model: negative binomial regression
feat3 <- c(
"betweenUtterancePauseNumber",
"totalFilledPauses",
"totalNoise",
"totalNoiseSentences",
"withinUtterancePause"
)

```



```{r}
feat4<-setdiff(colnames(whole_df)[8:61],c(feat1,feat2,feat3))
```


```{r}
# Standardize six regional tau measurements; preserve original scale call.
whole_df[,c(1:6)] <- scale(whole_df[,c(1:6)])
```

```{r}
# install.packages(c("glmmTMB", "marginaleffects"))
library(glmmTMB)
library(marginaleffects)
# Model the expected outcome using a zero-inflated beta regression and
# extract the average marginal effect of the selected predictor.
run_betaIZ <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str1 <- paste(" ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_str2 <- paste(outcome, formula_str1)
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj1 <- as.formula(formula_str1)
  formula_obj2 <- as.formula(formula_str2)
  
  # Fit zero-inflated beta regression model
  model <- glmmTMB(
    formula_obj2,  # mean of positive part (beta)
    ziformula = formula_obj1,  # zero-inflation model (Pr(“extra zero”))
    dispformula = formula_obj1, 
    family = beta_family(link = "logit"),
    data = data
  )
    
  # summary(model)
  
  # Average marginal effect of X on E[y | y>0, X]
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response",            # on the y scale, not logit
    re.form = NA
  )

  # summary(ave_me)
  return(ave_me)
}
```


```{r}
# Fit Gamma regression with log link; return its average marginal effect.
run_gamma <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str1 <- paste(" ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_str2 <- paste(outcome, formula_str1)
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj1 <- as.formula(formula_str1)
  formula_obj2 <- as.formula(formula_str2)
  
  # Fit Gamma regression (not zero-inflated beta).
  model <- glm(
    formula_obj2,  # mean of positive part (beta)
    family = Gamma(link = "log"),
    data = data
  )
    
  # summary(model)
  # 
  # confint(model)        # 95% CIs for coefficients

  # Average marginal effect of X on E[y | y>0, X]
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response"            # on the y scale, not logit
  )

  # summary(ave_me)
  return(ave_me)
}
```


```{r}
library(MASS)

# Fit negative-binomial regression for count-type features.
run_negbreg <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula string
  formula_str1 <- paste(" ~ ", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_str2 <- paste(outcome, formula_str1)
  
  # Convert to formula object
  formula_obj1 <- as.formula(formula_str1)
  formula_obj2 <- as.formula(formula_str2)
  
  # Fit negative-binomial regression.
  model <- glm.nb(
    formula_obj2,  # mean of positive part (beta)
    data = data
  )
    
  # summary(model)

  # confint(model)        # 95% CIs for coefficients

  # Average marginal effect of X on E[y | y>0, X]
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response"            # on the y scale, not logit
  )

  # summary(ave_me)
  return(ave_me)
}
```

```{r}
# Fit Gaussian regression for continuous features.
run_gaussian <- function(outcome, predictor, covariates, data) {
  # Combine predictor and covariates into a formula
  formula_str <- paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(predictor, covariates), collapse = " + "))
  formula_obj <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  # Fit Gaussian regression model
  model <- glm(
    formula_obj,
    family = gaussian(),
    data = data
  )
  
  # Main model summary
  # print(summary(model))
  # 
  # Confidence intervals
  # print(confint(model))
  
  # Average marginal effects
  ave_me <- avg_slopes(
    model,
    variables = predictor,
    type = "response"   # effect on the original scale
  )
  
  # print(summary(ave_me))
  
  return(ave_me)
}
```

```{r}
# Revised amyloid-composite associations across linguistic outcomes.
lm_featureDemoAmyloid <- data.frame()

for (feature in colnames(amyloid_feature_lmd)[1:61]) {

  if (feature %in% feat1) {
    print(feature)
    model_func <- run_betaIZ
    model_type <- "BetaIZ"
  } else if (feature %in% feat2) {
    model_func <- run_gamma
    model_type <- "Gamma"
  } else if (feature %in% feat3) {
    model_func <- run_negbreg
    model_type <- "NegBin"
  } else if (feature %in% c(feat4,'LMd',colnames(amyloid_feature_lmd)[1:6])) {
    model_func <- run_gaussian
    model_type <- "Gaussian"
  } else {
    warning(paste("Feature", feature, "not found in any type vector! Skipped."))
    next
  }
  ave_me <- model_func(
    outcome    = feature,
    predictor  = "ADNI.global.composite",
    covariates = c("age", "sex", "Educg"),
    data       = amyloid_feature_lmd
  )
  
  tmp <- data.frame(
    Feature      = ave_me$term,
    Estimate     = ave_me$estimate,
    StdError     = ave_me$std.error,
    t_or_z_Value = ave_me$statistic,
    Pr           = ave_me$p.value,
    Outcome       = feature,
    CI_Lower     = ave_me$conf.low,
    CI_Upper     = ave_me$conf.high,
    Dist         = model_type
  )
  
  lm_featureDemoAmyloid <- rbind(lm_featureDemoAmyloid, tmp)
}

```
```{r}
lm_featureDemoAmyloid_Select<-lm_featureDemoAmyloid[lm_featureDemoAmyloid$Feature=='ADNI.global.composite' & lm_featureDemoAmyloid$Pr<0.05,]
lm_featureDemoAmyloid_Select
```

#### Not control lmd. tau+age+sex+education+amyloid -> feature



```{r}

# Repeat revised regressions for six tau PET regions, adjusting for amyloid.
lm_featureDemoAmyloidTau <- data.frame()
for (tau in colnames(whole_df_clean[1:6])){
  for (feature in colnames(whole_df_clean)[7:61]) {
    if (feature %in% feat1) {
      model_func <- run_betaIZ
      model_type <- "BetaIZ"
    } else if (feature %in% feat2) {
      model_func <- run_gamma
      model_type <- "Gamma"
    } else if (feature %in% feat3) {
      model_func <- run_negbreg
      model_type <- "NegBin"
    } else if (feature %in% c(feat4,'LMd')) {
      model_func <- run_gaussian
      model_type <- "Gaussian"
    } else {
      warning(paste("Feature", feature, "not found in any type vector! Skipped."))
      next
    }
    
    ave_me <- model_func(
      outcome    = feature,
      predictor  = tau,
      covariates = c("age", "sex", "Educg","ADNI.global.composite"),
      data       = whole_df_clean
    )
    
    tmp <- data.frame(
      Feature      = ave_me$term,
      Estimate     = ave_me$estimate,
      StdError     = ave_me$std.error,
      t_or_z_Value = ave_me$statistic,
      Pr           = ave_me$p.value,
      Outcome       = feature,
      CI_Lower     = ave_me$conf.low,
      CI_Upper     = ave_me$conf.high,
      Dist         = model_type
    )
    
    lm_featureDemoAmyloidTau <- rbind(lm_featureDemoAmyloidTau, tmp)
  }
}

```

      outcome    = feature,
      predictor  = tau,
      covariates = c("age", "sex", "Educg","ADNI.petpos",'LMd'),
